import pychrono as chrono

system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)
system.SetGravitationalAcceleration(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, -9.81))  # Set gravity in the negative Z direction
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedEnvelope(0.0025)
chrono.ChCollisionModel.SetDefaultSuggestedMargin(0.0025)

# Create Viper rover

driver = viper.ViperDCMotorControl()  # Create a driver for the rover
rover.SetDriver(driver)  # Assign the driver to the rover

# Initialize rover position and orientation
init_pos = chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0.2, 0)
init_rot = chrono.ChQuaterniond(1, 0, 0, 0)
rover.Initialize(chrono.ChFramed(init_pos, init_rot))

# Create run-time visualization
vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.AttachSystem(system)
vis.SetCameraVertical(chrono.CameraVerticalDir_Z)
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
vis.SetWindowTitle('Viper rover - Rigid terrain')
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))

vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVector3d(1.5, -2.5, 5.5), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5), 3, 4, 10, 40, 512)

# Enable shadows (commented out to improve performance)
# vis.EnableShadows()

# Set the simulation time step
time_step = 1e-3

# Simulation loop
time = 0
while vis.Run():
    time += time_step  # Increment the simulation time
    steering = 0
    max_steering = math.pi / 6  # Maximum steering angle
    
    # Define the steering behavior over time
    if 2 < time < 7:
        steering = max_steering * (time - 2) / 5  # Gradually increase steering
    elif 7 < time < 12:
        steering = max_steering * (12 - time) / 5  # Gradually decrease steering
    
    driver.SetSteering(steering)  # Set the steering for the rover

    rover.Update()  # Update the rover's state

    # Render the scene
    vis.BeginScene()
    vis.Render()
    vis.EndScene()
    
    # Advance the simulation by one time step
    system.DoStepDynamics(time_step)

```python
import math
import numpy as np
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.robot as viper
import pychrono.vehicle as veh

# Create Chrono system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)

vis.AddCamera(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 2.5, 1.5), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 1))
vis.AddTypicalLights()
vis.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVector3d(1.5, -2.5, 5.5), chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0.5), 3, 4, 10, 40, 512)

# Enable shadows (commented out to improve performance)
# vis.EnableShadows()

# Set the simulation time step
time_step = 1e-3

# Simulation loop
time = 0
while vis.Run():
    time += time_step  # Increment the simulation time

    # Set steering to a constant value of 0.0
    steering = 0.0
    driver.SetSteering(steering)  # Set the steering for the rover

    rover.Update()  # Update the rover's state
```

```python
import pychrono.core as chrono
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.geom as geom

# Initialize the PyChrono environment
chrono.SetChronoDataPath('../data/')  # Set the path to the Chrono data directory

# Create a Chrono::Engine physical system
system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -9.81, 0))  # Set gravity

# Create the ground body

ground.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(0, -0.25, 0))
system.Add(ground)

# Create the Viper rover
rover = veh.Viper()
rover.SetChassisBody(system, chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0.5, 0))  # Set initial position of the rover

# Initialize the driver for the Viper rover
driver = veh.ViperDriver(rover.GetVehicle())
driver.SetSteeringMode(veh.ViperDriver.STEERING_MODE_SPEED)

# Create an Irrlicht visualization
visualization = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(system, 'Viper Rover Simulation', chronoirr.dimension2du(800, 600))
visualization.AddTypicalSky()
visualization.AddTypicalLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_red.png'))
visualization.AddLightWithShadow(chrono.ChVectorD(1.0, -1.0, 1.0), chrono.ChVectorD(0.2, 0.2, 0.2), 100, 100, 100, 40, 512)
camera = visualization.AddCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(5, -5, 5), chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0))

# Set up the simulation loop
steering_change_duration = 10  # Time period over which steering changes
steering_change_start_time = 0  # Start time for steering change
steering_change_end_time = steering_change_start_time + steering_change_duration

def update_steering(time):
    if steering_change_start_time <= time <= steering_change_end_time:
        # Gradually change steering from -1 to 1 over the specified duration
        steering = -1 + 2 * (time - steering_change_start_time) / steering_change_duration
        driver.SetSteering(steering)

def simulation_step(time):
    system.DoStepDynamics(0.01)  # Time step for the simulation
    update_steering(time)
    visualization.Render()

# Run the simulation loop
time = 0
while visualization.Run():
    simulation_step(time)
    time += 0.01
```
